answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 159535 Country: India Title: Will wudhu break or not if blood comes from ninor injury? Question: A very minor injury/ bruising of finger above nails occurred in morning when I stepped from home. I was with wudhu. Blood was on wound only. But after some time, I did inn (inn for office) shirt inside trouser and in this act the blood got spread due to cloth and fingers going in with below trouser part. So did my wudhu break? I kept reading Quran on journey considering wudhu did not break. Answer ID: 159535 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 791/707/SN=8/1439) In the question mentioned above your wudhu had broken. If you have recited the Holy Quran in the same state holding the Holy Quran in your hand then you committed an unlawful act, you should do taubah and istighfar. And if you did not hold the Holy Quran in your hand then you did no wrong. According to Shariah, wudhu is not necessary to recite the Holy Quran verbally. وينقضه خروج كل خارج نجس ... منه أي من المتوضئ الحي معتادًا أو لا، من السبيلين أو لا إلى ما يطهر ... ثم المراد بالخروج من السبيلين مجرد الظهور وفى غيرها عين السيلان ولو بالقوة الخ (در مختار مع الشامى 1/260، وبعده، ط: زكريا) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
